title: IPv6 fixed header
summary: The IPv6 fixed header is 40 bytes: version (4 bits) + traffic class (8) + flow label (20), payload length (16), next header (8), hop limit (8), source address (128), destination address (128).

ext.summary: The IPv6 fixed header is 40 bytes: version (4 bits) + traffic class (8) + flow label (20), payload length (16), next header (8), hop limit (8), source address (128), destination address (128).

structure.meaning: Flow identifier for QoS; 0 means no flow.
Length of everything after the 40-byte fixed header.
Protocol of the next header (6 TCP, 17 UDP, 58 ICMPv6, 43 routing, ...).
Decremented per hop; packet discarded at 0.

ext.example_decoded: Version 6, no traffic class/flow, payload length 0, next header 6 (TCP), hop limit 64, src/dest 2001:db8::1 -> 2001:db8::2
notes: Fixed 40-byte header; extension headers (hop-by-hop, routing, fragment, ...) follow via Next Header chaining.
Addresses are 128 bits; flow label supports per-flow QoS without deep packet inspection.
